lines.text: Reuben's birthright went to the sons of Joseph because he defiled his father's bed, though a ruler came from Judah.
Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried Beerah into exile, and in the days of Saul the Reubenites defeated the Hagrites.
The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Moab, as far as Salecah.
Because they trusted God, the Hagrites were delivered to them, and they seized 50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 3,000 donkeys.
The half-tribe of Manasseh was unfaithful to God, so God stirred up Pul king of Assyria to exile them.
